verdict.rationale: Bento's Events API explicitly supports tracking custom events per subscriber, updating profile fields, and triggering automations tied to that person, and flows can be built from behavior/events/tags with branch checks. This directly matches firing a custom event to trigger a per-person automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and no explicit example showing event-to-single-person automation trigger end-to-end.
